mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fair_dates (fair_id, operation_date, capacity, entry_start_time, entry_end_time, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fairId}, #{operationDate}, #{capacity}, #{entryStartTime}, #{entryEndTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.sql: SELECT fd.fair_date_id , fd.fair_id , fd.operation_date , fd.capacity , fd.entry_start_time , fd.entry_end_time , fd.created_at , fd.updated_at , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reservations r WHERE r.fair_id = fd.fair_id AND r.visit_date = fd.operation_date AND r.reservation_type = 'ADVANCE' AND r.status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'CONFIRMED', 'CHECKED_IN')) AS reserved_count , EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM onsite_sales_policies osp WHERE osp.fair_date_id = fd.fair_date_id) AS onsite_sales_configured FROM fair_dates fd
mapper.select: WHERE fd.fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY fd.operation_date ASC
